headline: Meta Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Meta reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $64.60 billion, up 26% year over year, and net income of $9.86 billion. The company also announced the establishment of publicly listed, non-voting Class C common stock and a one-time stock dividend of one Class C share for each outstanding Class A and Class B share, subject to the stated conditions.

headline: Alphabet Announces Dividend on Series A and Series B Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock
summary: Alphabet’s Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $15.63 per share on each Series A and Series B mandatory convertible preferred stock, equivalent to approximately $0.78 per depositary share. The dividend is payable November 15, 2026, to stockholders of record as of November 1, 2026.

headline: Meta Announces Pricing of Offering of Depositary Shares Representing Series A Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock and Offering of Class A Common Stock in Connection with Forward Sale Agreements
summary: Meta announced pricing for concurrent offerings of 250 million depositary shares at $50 each and $25 billion of Class A common stock at $625 per share, with the common stock offering upsized from $22.5 billion. The offerings are expected to close on October 29, 2026, and Meta intends to use proceeds from the preferred stock offering and future settlement of the forward sale agreements for general corporate purposes.

headline: Meta to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Meta Platforms, Inc. announced that it will release its third-quarter 2026 financial results after market close on October 21, 2026.

headline: Alphabet Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Alphabet reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $127.6 billion, up 25% year over year, with Google Cloud revenue increasing 103% to $30.7 billion. Operating income rose 30% to $40.6 billion, while net income available to common stockholders was $26.2 billion and diluted EPS was $2.12.

headline: Meet the 2026 App Store Award finalists
summary: Apple announced 45 finalists for the 2026 App Store Awards, recognizing developers whose apps and games demonstrate exceptional innovation, user experience, design, and cultural impact. Winners will be announced in the coming weeks.

headline: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Third Quarter Fiscal 2027
summary: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today reported revenue for the third quarter ended October 25, 2026, of $115.8 billion, up 20% from the previous quarter and up 103% from a year ago. For the quarter, GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins were 74.8% and 74.9%, respectively. GAAP and non-GAAP earnings per diluted share were $2.70 and $2.68, respectively. “Our momentum is real. NVIDIA is an exceptional technology leader, powered by the relentless innovation of our people,” said Colette Kress, interim CEO and executive vice president and chief financial officer of NVIDIA. “Vera Rubin is off to an explosive start, our roadmap is on track and our ambition has never been greater.”

headline: Meta Announces Launch of Offering of Depositary Shares Representing Series A Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock and Offering of Class A Common Stock in Connection with Forward Sale Agreements
summary: Meta announced concurrent underwritten public offerings of approximately $12.5 billion in depositary shares representing Series A Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock and $22.5 billion of Class A common stock in connection with forward sale agreements. The offerings are part of a financing plan to support Meta’s continued investment in AI infrastructure and personal superintelligence.

headline: NVIDIA Expands Commitments With Supply Chain Partners to Support AI Infrastructure Buildout
summary: News Summary: NVIDIA today announced expanded commitments with supply chain partners to support sustainable long-term growth, aligning supply and manufacturing capacity with demand for its accelerated computing and AI infrastructure platforms.

headline: Formula 1® returns to the U.S. this weekend with the Las Vegas Grand Prix™, streaming live on Apple TV
summary: Apple announced that the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix will stream free in the U.S. on Apple TV, with every session live and on demand, English and Spanish commentary, and customizable viewing features including Multiview and additional live feeds. The announcement also highlights related F1 programming and race-week coverage across Apple services.
